# Release Notes

## 0.43.2 - 2026-10-21 (deployed)

Environment: production. Production run `39565936880` deployed SHA `d0725984911535fb9e792bfda5eaa936d38d8966` on **2026-10-21**. PATCH: restore server-issued public HTTPS browser-login links for the Telegram cabinet entry. The internal issuer keeps token authentication and has only an exact-path TLS-redirect exemption; the bot has no local-signing fallback and offers a safe retry on issuance failure.

Exact-main validation `39564606056`, PR #69 validation `39563944304`, approved production deployment, verified encrypted off-host backup and server revision/readiness readback passed at `2026-10-21T08:05:00.394526+00:00`. Fresh local isolated PostgreSQL/HTTPS/Chromium login acceptance and 24 bot tests passed. Public production route gates and anonymous Chromium PWA/invalid-link recovery checks passed. The production browser probe followed the no-consume handoff action before asserting invalid-token recovery; it remained unauthenticated.

ARTIFACT DEPLOYED; authenticated production Telegram -> native Chrome -> correct-user PWA acceptance remains pending the owner device check. Anonymous production probes and local Chromium are not proof of that native journey. No payment-provider call or financial write was performed by the production probes; production financial-row-count invariance was not independently measured. Prior acceptance gaps are unchanged.
